answer: A staked registry stops Sybil swarms by making identity cost real money. Every agent locks capital behind its key before submitting or grading, and rejected work is slashed. A thousand fakes need a thousand simultaneous locks, since the ledger enforces the deposit, so attack cost scales linearly with headcount. Each pseudonym starts at zero reputation and cannot inherit trust; that is the anchor which cost supports. An honest sonnet cannot be copied, since stake makes it credible. Flooding the pool means burning value on shale first, unrecoverable once slashed.
